questions.question:
The following pie-chart represents a total expenditure of Rs. 2,28,000 on different items in constructing a house in a town.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf7b16cb821458d79fa3976fd3f12885c4dfd833295877f1ac15f71280a1089a.png] 

What is the total expenditure done on Steel, Cement and Tiles?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Total expenditure on different items is Rs2,28,000

**CONCEPT USED:**

100% represents total expenditure 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, 100% = Rs2,28,000

⇒ 1% = Rs2280.

Now, expenditure done on steel, cement and tiles are 18%, 19% and 9% respectively.

Total expenditure = ( 18 + 19 + 9)% = 46%.

As 1% = 2280

⇒ 46% = 46 × 2280 = Rs104,880

**Hence, total expenditure is Rs104,880.**

questions.solution:
**Given:**

A pie chart showing the percentage shares of the total expenditure,

On sports made by a country on various sports during 2019-2020

**Formula used:**

Quantity of the part = percentage × the total quantity of the whole.

**Calculation:**

According to the pie chart,

The percentage of the total amount spent on hockey is 15%.

15% of 260 = (15)/(100)× 260=39.

**∴ If the total amount spent on sports during 2019-2020 was ₹260 crores, then the amount spent on hockey is ₹39 crores.**

Percentage of the student in school S = 22%

Percentage students of school T to school Q and S together

**Concept used :**

[(Student in school T)/(student in school Q + stud
ent in school S)] × 100

questions.question:
The pie-chart given below shows the monthly expenditures made by a family under different heads as percentages of the total monthly income of the family. If the total monthly income of the family is ₹70,000, then what is the amount that is left with the family after only the food and medical expenditures for the month are made?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0762f823fb7f763a92e41260de604191ce238814df60a3a9122fd46d0f153851.png]
questions.solution:
Given:

Total monthly income of a family = Rs 70,000

Percentage of expenditure for food = 28%

Percentage of expenditure for house rent = 14%

Percentage of expenditure for child education = 25%

Percentage of expenditure for medical = 10%

Percentage of expenditure for entertainment = 8%

Percentage of expenditure for provident fund = 15%

Concept Used:

Income left = Total Income – Income Spend

Calculation:

Amount spent on food = 28% of 70,000

Amount spent on food = (28)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 19,600

Amount spent on medical = 10% of 70,000

Amount spend on medical = (10)/(100) × 70000 = Rs 7,000

Total amount spent in food and medical = Rs 19,600 + Rs 7,000 = Rs 26,600

Amount left after spending on food and medical = Rs 70,000 – Rs 26,600 = Rs 43,400

∴ The amount left with the family after only the food and medical expenditures for the month is Rs 43,400

questions.question:
The pie chart given below shows the number of students enrolled in class VI to class X of a school. If 1250 students are enrolled in VI to X, then find the sum of students enrolled in class VIII and IX.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2db604bfacb247058470ce4f850f6f323397ddb95b4abf559ee24c0241f036b3.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total students enrolled (VI to X) = 1250

Percentage of students in class VIII = 20%

Percentage of students in class IX = 26%

**Formula used:**

Number of students in a class = (Percentage of students in that class / 100) × Total students

**Calculation:**

Number of students in class VIII = (20 / 100) × 1250

⇒ Number of students in class VIII = 0.20 × 1250

⇒ Number of students in class VIII = 250

Number of students in class IX = (26 / 100) × 1250

⇒ Number of students in class IX = 0.26 × 1250

⇒ Number of students in class IX = 325

Sum of students in class VIII and IX = 250 + 325

⇒ Sum of students in class VIII and IX = 575

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40637e605effda0e176b764a52bdfadf252d8cd7a1858c4e19a7c7ae40344703.png] 

If the income from the market tax in a year is ₹260 crore, then the total income from other sources is : (in ₹ crore)
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

⇒ Income from the market tax in a year is ₹260 crore

⇒ Let the total income from all the sources be x crores

⇒ Percentage of income from the market tax = 26%

⇒ So, according to the question

⇒(26)/(100) × x = 260 

⇒ x = 260 × (100)/(26) = 1000

⇒ Total income from all the sources = 1000

⇒ Income from other sources other than market tax = 1000 – 260 = 740

**Therefore, the total income from other sources is ₹740 crore.**

If the total expenditure on education is Rs. 23,520, then what is the expenditure on clothing (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total expenditure on education = ₹23,520

Percentage spent on education = 28%

Percentage spent on clothing = 12%

**Formula used:**

Total Expenditure = (Expenditure on education / Percentage spent on education) × 100

Expenditure on clothing = (Percentage spent on clothing / 100) × Total Expenditure

**Calculation:**

Total Expenditure = (23,520 / 28) × 100 = 84,000

Expenditure on clothing = (12 / 100) × 84,000

⇒ Expenditure on clothing = 10,080

**∴ The expenditure on clothing is ₹10,080.**
